notes:
v2.0.0 Update
- On-screen shop editor: Double-click text to edit it, drag and resize the NPC and speech bubble, and adjust fonts and accent color. Select overlapping elements and preview product or purchase screens without a transaction. Undo and redo are included.
- Custom backgrounds: Use separate shop and NPC images with fitting, position, scale, and opacity controls. Keep theme surroundings, adjust blur from 0 to 60 px, use a solid color or repeat, or stretch the image to fill the window by changing its proportions.
- Shop Settings: Six searchable sections, a persistent save bar, and draft editing with Apply or Save & close. Saving preserves purchases and scheduled stock changes made while editing.
- Catalog tools: Search products, filter stock, select multiple entries, and choose individual items from searchable folder and compendium imports.
- Presets and settings copying: Save selected settings as world presets or copy them from another shop. Choose appearance, audio, economy rules, relationship ranks, and categories with or without items.
- Shop duplication: Copy the current draft's settings and catalog into a new Actor with fresh player progress. Automatic restocking starts disabled.
- Scheduled restocking: Choose an interval in game days and a time. Automatic runs refill stock and refresh generated price variance; missed intervals catch up once when a GM returns.
- Random product rotation: Optionally redraw category products from Stock Pools on the restocking schedule, using their weights, exclusions, item-count ranges, and stock ranges. Empty or unreadable pools keep existing products.
- Sold-out cleanup: Optionally remove sold-out products while keeping source Items and unlimited stock. Ordinary restocking only refills products still listed; removed products can return through manual additions or Stock Pool draws.
- Purchase quantities: Type a quantity or use +5, +10, and MAX. MAX checks the selected payment source, stock, and required items, up to 99 units. Shift changes plus/minus steps to 5; Ctrl/Cmd changes them to 10.
- Shop browser: Browse or search visible world Actor shops through GlitchSmith Menu and open one through buyer selection.
- Fixes: Corrected currency settlement and failed-transaction recovery, custom quantity paths, import ordering, and duplicate selling with multiple GMs.

Requires GlitchSmith Library 0.13.0 or later. Supports Foundry VTT 13 and 14.
Full patch notes on Patreon

announcement.title: 🛍️ Stylish Shop v2.0.0
announcement.content:
Stylish Shop v2.0.0 adds an on-screen editor, redesigned shop management, and scheduled stock automation.

On-screen shop editor

Double-click text to edit it, drag and resize the NPC and speech bubble, and adjust fonts and accent color. Select overlapping elements and preview product or purchase screens without a transaction. Undo and redo are included.

Custom backgrounds

Use separate shop and NPC images with fitting, position, scale, and opacity controls. Keep theme surroundings, adjust blur from 0 to 60 px, use a solid color or repeat, or stretch the image to fill the window by changing its proportions.

Shop Settings

Six searchable sections, a persistent save bar, and draft editing with Apply or Save & close. Saving preserves purchases and scheduled stock changes made while editing.

Catalog tools

Search products, filter stock, select multiple entries, and choose individual items from searchable folder and compendium imports.

Presets and settings copying

Save selected settings as world presets or copy them from another shop. Choose appearance, audio, economy rules, relationship ranks, and categories with or without items.

Shop duplication

Copy the current draft's settings and catalog into a new Actor with fresh player progress. Automatic restocking starts disabled.

Scheduled restocking

Choose an interval in game days and a time. Automatic runs refill stock and refresh generated price variance; missed intervals catch up once when a GM returns.

Random product rotation

Optionally redraw category products from Stock Pools on the restocking schedule, using their weights, exclusions, item-count ranges, and stock ranges. Empty or unreadable pools keep existing products.

Sold-out cleanup

Optionally remove sold-out products while keeping source Items and unlimited stock. Ordinary restocking only refills products still listed; removed products can return through manual additions or Stock Pool draws.

Purchase quantities

Type a quantity or use +5, +10, and MAX. MAX checks the selected payment source, stock, and required items, up to 99 units. Shift changes plus/minus steps to 5; Ctrl/Cmd changes them to 10.

Shop browser

Browse or search visible world Actor shops through GlitchSmith Menu and open one through buyer selection.

Fixes

Corrected currency settlement and failed-transaction recovery, custom quantity paths, import ordering, and duplicate selling with multiple GMs.

Requires GlitchSmith Library 0.13.0 or later. Supports Foundry VTT 13 and 14.

Full patch notes on Patreon
